content: {"praised":["Timeless story of pain, love, loss, and unity.","Complex and subtle undertones hidden in simple plot.","Spectacular performances by Rene Bazinet and other circus artists.","Beautiful visuals and enchanting fable atmosphere.","Engaging music that complements the narrative."],"criticized":["Story is silly, inconsequential, and nonsensical.","Poor casting choices, especially overweight Frank Langella.","Circus performers shown only in brief episodes.","Disappointing for fans expecting full Cirque show.","Lack of elephants and traditional Cirque elements."]}
